title: FineDeb: A Debiasing Framework for Language Models
reasoning: The paper explicitly evaluates its debiasing framework on the demographic of religion as one of three main categories. It includes curated word lists for multiple faiths (Islam, Christianity, Judaism, Hinduism, Buddhism, Confucianism, and Taoism) and uses benchmarks like StereoSet and SEAT to measure and mitigate bias against these groups.
